verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents its own registered-agent service, including receiving service of process with phone notification and state forms pre-filled with its registered-agent address, and it tracks registrations across states. No cited text states that this registered-agent coverage spans every US state; the "all states" claim refers to annual-report filing, which is a different capability, and the national-registered-agent page excerpt covers only pricing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of registered-agent coverage in all 50 states, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state appointment coverage.

support.subject: As a founder, one provider covers registered-agent service in every US state, so registering in a new state does not mean finding a new vendor

citations.quote: Receive critical legal documents electronically and be notified by phone when you receive service of process, ensuring you never miss a document.
Instantly access state forms pre-filled with our registered agent address for simplified filing.
Identify registrations across states, monitor entity statuses
